description: A records retention policy of an invented housing association, written as a Word document with python-docx: numbered headings and paragraphs (automatic multi-level list), a portrait section, a landscape section with the retention schedule table (Appendix A) and a portrait section for document control; Arial is substituted by Liberation Sans. The PDFs were rendered by LibreOffice 24.2 from the Office files (headless --convert-to pdf), not by Microsoft Office. The new version is the draft as circulated with tracked changes shown: one sentence added as a tracked insertion (LibreOffice shows it underlined in the reviewer colour with a change bar in the left margin) and one paragraph removed as a tracked deletion (still shown, struck through in the reviewer colour, with a change bar). Several other edits were made with tracking switched off, so they are not marked in the new PDF: the backup deletion period, one retention period and one owner in the landscape table, and a new row in the version history; the footer also changed. Consequences that are not listed: the change bars themselves; LibreOffice shows the list number of the deleted paragraph as "[4.3]" and that of the next paragraph as "4.3[4.4]", both in the reviewer colour (automatic renumbering shown as part of the redline); page 1 re-flows, and the R09 row in the landscape table becomes two lines tall.
